hydration.name: Water
hydration.suggestion: Drink water regularly according to your thirst, activity and environment.
hydration.note: Adequate hydration supports general health and normal body functions.

coconut_water.name: Coconut Water
coconut_water.suggestion: Can be included as an occasional refreshing beverage.
coconut_water.note: It is not a treatment for skin conditions or a method to change skin tone.

lemon_water.name: Lemon Water
lemon_water.suggestion: Can be used as a refreshing drink if you enjoy it.
lemon_water.note: It does not directly change skin tone.

fruit.name: Fruits
fruit.suggestion: Include a variety of fruits as part of a balanced diet.
fruit.note: Fruits support overall nutrition but are not a treatment for skin conditions.

vegetables.name: Vegetables
vegetables.suggestion: Include a variety of vegetables as part of a balanced diet.

balanced_diet.name: Balanced Diet
balanced_diet.suggestion: Aim for a varied diet containing appropriate sources of protein, carbohydrates, healthy fats, fruits and vegetables.

sleep.name: Regular Sleep
sleep.suggestion: Maintain a consistent sleep routine and aim for adequate sleep.
sleep.note: Sleep supports general health and wellbeing.
